gloss: winning and losing, victory and defeat

definitions.gloss: winning and losing, victory and defeat, the outcome
definitions.explanation: The result or outcome of a competition, expressed as the combined concept of winning and losing. Often used when discussing whether outcomes matter, the nature of competition, or results in general.

examples.japanese: {勝|か}ち{負|ま}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気|き}にしない→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧。
examples.english: I don't care about winning or losing.

examples.japanese: ⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{勝|か}ち{負|ま}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦はっきりする→はっきりする：26886_hakkirisuru⟧。
examples.english: In sports, the outcome is clear-cut.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{勝|か}ち{負|ま}け⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわらない→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えたい→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: I want to teach children the importance of not being fixated solely on winning and losing.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{勝|か}ち→勝ち：02540_kachi⟧ (winning) and ⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧ (losing), treating the two as a single concept. Often used in contexts discussing whether outcomes matter, or when talking about competition philosophy.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {勝|か}ち{負|ま}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧ (to be fixated on winning/losing)
- {勝|か}ち{負|ま}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ (to determine the outcome)
- {勝|か}ち{負|ま}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (winning or losing doesn't matter)
- {勝|か}ち{負|ま}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく (an outcome is decided)
